title: FHWA Highway Statistics: travel, drivers, vehicles, roads, motor fuel and highway finance by state
agency: U.S. Department of Transportation, Federal Highway Administration
questions: miles driven per capita by state
licensed drivers by age and sex
public road miles by state and functional system
Highway Trust Fund receipts attributable to each state

manual.how: Open https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/policyinformation/statistics/<year>/<table>.cfm (e.g. 2023/vm2.cfm), click the XLSX link, save the workbook and upload it with ingest.

cache.why: Tables are revised in place during the year; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: FHWA statistics are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: U.S. Department of Transportation, Federal Highway Administration, Highway Statistics {dataset}, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which edition and year? Highway Statistics <year> tables mostly hold that year's data (VM-2 2023 = travel in 2023); tables are revised in later editions. Default: the latest edition that has the table.

Which table? Travel VM-2 (by functional system), drivers DL-22, vehicles MV-1, road length HM-20, motor fuel MF-1, trust fund FE-9. Default: the table whose title matches the question, named in the answer.
